title: AuspexAI Result Envelope v0.1
description: Result-envelope schema. The payload field is tenant-defined and opaque to the AuspexAI platform. worker_signature is added at submission time by the worker (Ed25519 signature over the canonical encoding of the other fields). Immutable once published.

worker_pubkey.description: Raw Ed25519 public key (32 bytes), lowercase hex-encoded.

payload.description: Tenant-defined result content. Opaque to the AuspexAI platform.

worker_signature.description: Base64-encoded Ed25519 signature over canonical JSON encoding of the other fields.
